Senses.Explanation: Old in years and solitary at heart combines bodily age with isolation or anxious self-positioning. An unnamed monk addresses Xutang with it, Baiyun and Baichi use it in self-description, and Fojian’s marked appraisals apply it to Guishan amid the Yangshan–Xiangyan case.
